userDecision.request: Codex should decide and create the narrative/content roster-and-class-identity packet, followed by a coordination specification before engineering.
userDecision.authority: This request authorizes Codex to make and record the creative proposal. The user retains final creative, product, visual, balance, irreversible-profile, playtest, milestone, and release approval.

mainQuestPacket.policy: Reference CH11 High Sky Trials and CH12 Eight Lights without editing or duplicating their critical path.

canonicalDecisions.terminology: The four inherited ClassFamily values are class families. The sixteen inherited non-None SubclassId values are the sixteen playable classes. The three branches inside each class are skill-tree specializations, not additional classes.
canonicalDecisions.classSelection: A character selects one of the sixteen playable classes directly. Family is derived from the explicit mapping and is never selected or persisted independently. Class choice is character-scoped; same-realm subcharacters may choose different classes. Ordinary skill respec cannot change class.
canonicalDecisions.realmAvailability: All sixteen classes are available to Stonehold, Eldergrove, Crownlands, and Umbral. Realm changes culture, materials, language, heraldry, animation flavor, and VFX palette, but not class mechanics, role eligibility, or skill-tree topology.

supportCoverage.policy: Healing, shielding, cleansing, buffing, debuffing, control, scouting, interruption, rescue, and objective support are valid contribution identities and must not be treated as inferior to killing blows.

treeTopology.branchAccess: Branches are non-exclusive identity paths. A player may invest across all three. Later keystone choice groups may be mutually exclusive only when explicitly authored and validated.
treeTopology.level50Meaning: The level-50 milestone is the normal class-tree capstone. It is not a True Warmaster skill.
treeTopology.slotPolicy: The initial production loadout remains four active slots. Passive nodes are not slotted. True Warmaster skills use the same loadout surface unless a later approved input contract creates another surface.
treeTopology.fullNodeCatalogStatus: Only class identity, three branches, and five defining milestone skills are authored here. Non-milestone nodes, ranks, point costs, prerequisite edges, numeric behavior, and balance remain a later source-and-balance completion.

masteryTrialPolicy.legacyDisposition: The sixteen discarded level-100 soul-quest concepts are superseded as level-50 class mastery trials with new stable IDs and preserved SQ_* aliases.
masteryTrialPolicy.storyWindow: Available after level 50 within the High Sky Trials and Eight Lights era.
masteryTrialPolicy.mechanicalGate: A mastery trial does not grant or gate the level-50 capstone, required level progress, Warmaster eligibility, True Warmaster eligibility, gem custody, final-wish access, or the canonical ending.
masteryTrialPolicy.rewardBoundary: Narrative recognition, class title presentation, cosmetic remembrance, or optional lore only until a separately approved reward packet exists.
masteryTrialPolicy.failure: Failure is recoverable and nonterminal; retry begins at the latest safe objective without consuming eligibility.
masteryTrialPolicy.abandonment: The trial may be paused or abandoned and reaccepted without changing class, tree allocation, Warmaster state, or critical-path progress.
masteryTrialPolicy.resume: Reload restores the current trial and safe objective when runtime support exists; any one-time recognition is duplicate-safe.

trueWarmasterPolicy.campaignMeaning: CH11 establishes Warmaster purpose; CH12 carries level 50, Warzone points, Warmaster gear, and True Warmaster progression.
trueWarmasterPolicy.eligibility: Level 50, the approved realm contract, sufficient committed Warzone points, and all ten unique valid pieces of the selected class's Warmaster set.
trueWarmasterPolicy.classSpecificity: Every class has one named title, one named set, one unique class relic, and one True Warmaster RvR skill identity.
trueWarmasterPolicy.counterplay: Every True Warmaster skill requires a visible telegraph, bounded area or duration, explicit escape, interruption, destruction, resistance, or preparation counterplay, scalable VFX, and no instant-kill or unconditional invulnerability.
trueWarmasterPolicy.sideQuestBoundary: Optional side quests and class mastery trials cannot grant or gate Warmaster or True Warmaster eligibility.

visualPerformanceBoundary.classReadability: Class must read through posture, equipment silhouette, major shapes, and animation intent rather than color alone.
visualPerformanceBoundary.realmExpression: Realm VFX and materials overlay class identity without changing skill behavior.
visualPerformanceBoundary.summonsAndTransformation: Companions, servants, anchors, roots, and decoys are explicitly bounded. Druid launch identity uses spectral Wild Aspects rather than requiring a full separate transformed-model roster.
visualPerformanceBoundary.accessibility: Telegraphs retain shape, icon, motion, text, or silhouette cues independent of color and support reduced-motion and reduced-flash presentation.

visualClassLabels.decision: Cursor is not a playable class and is not silently corrected to Curser. Its curse and debuff motifs are distributed among the listed canonical classes.

prototypeWarmaster.decision: The generic set, caller-supplied price, raw ten-item count, and generic class relic do not define any canonical class set or entitlement.

externalCapabilityRequests: A versioned class catalog that maps each canonical class ID to exactly one family and all four realms.
Character-scoped class selection with same-realm subcharacter support and no ordinary class change through skill respec.
Versioned class resource and mechanic profiles with visible gain, spend, cap, recovery, and unavailable-state behavior.
Three-branch skill trees visible from level 1 with durable point grants, allocation, respec, recovery, and four-slot loadouts.
Contribution accounting for healing, shielding, cleansing, buffing, debuffing, control, scouting, interruption, rescue, companion support, and objective play.
Recoverable, non-gating level-50 class mastery trials using the preserved celestial themes.
Sixteen class-specific Warmaster sets, unique class relics, and True Warmaster skills with authoritative eligibility, ledgers, transactions, counterplay, accessibility, and quality tiers.
unresolvedDecisions: User final creative and visual approval of this Codex-authored roster and all new names.
Full non-milestone node inventory, node ranks, prerequisites, keystone choices, point costs, and respec policy.
Numerical stats, resource caps and rates, cooldowns, cast/channel times, ranges, scaling, power, contribution weights, and PvE/PvP/RvR balance.
Exact weapon and armor catalog categories, animations, icons, audio, models, VFX profiles, and class-specific realm presentation.
Warmaster prices, exact Warzone-point threshold, whether points are lifetime qualification or spendable currency, gear acquisition sources, and historical entitlement migration.
Production reward copy and optional cosmetic outcomes for the sixteen class mastery trials.
